guide.reason: Current working version references advance from 0.3.5 to 0.3.6 so operators and maintainers read the same number the Release workflow will stamp.

api.reason: Release metadata and guide version labels only; no Controller/Core contract change.

roadmap.reason: Version bump only; no milestone status change.

state.reason: Version metadata adds no durable product state.
